title: Pasting and identity for termwise closed direct-image exchange
statement: Let A be a commutative ring. For a Cartesian square h:Z′→Z, i′:Z′→T′, i:Z→T, g:T′→T with i,i′ closed immersions, let c be the canonical isomorphism D+(i_*)⋙D+(g*) ≅ D+(h*)⋙D+(i′_*) obtained by termwise localization of the ordinary finite exchange [lemma-weil-pbc-finite-exchange], with the exact-localization compositors [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization]. For two successive such squares, the inverse square c_composite^{-1} equals the horizontal composite of the two inverse squares whiskered on top by upperStarCompDerivedPlus(h₂,h).hom and on bottom by upperStarCompDerivedPlus(g₂,g).inv. For an identity horizontal square, its inverse exchange is the unitor square whiskered on top by upperStarIdDerivedPlus(Z).hom and on bottom by upperStarIdDerivedPlus(T).inv. These identities hold for arbitrary base changes, independently of any support adjunction or ind-etale assumption.

proof.text: All inverse images and closed direct images are exact. Apply each functor and each natural transformation termwise to bounded below complexes and localize. Localization preserves the two ordinary equations. Identify its compositors with mapDerivedCategoryPlusCompIso and its image of an ordinary isomorphism with mapDerivedCategoryPlusNatIso. The induced inverse-image compositors are exactly upperStarCompDerivedPlus and upperStarIdDerivedPlus.
Invert the exchange isomorphisms and cancel the composition or identity isomorphisms. Componentwise this reverses the order of the factors and yields precisely the two stated TwoSquare identities.

theorem closedDirectImagePlus_coherence (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] :
    let c := fun {Z Z' T T' : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ T) (i' : Z' ⟶ T')
      [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsClosedImmersion i']
      (h : Z' ⟶ Z) (g : T' ⟶ T) (sq : IsPullback h i' i g) =>
      have := isIso_baseChangeMap_of_isFinite (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) sq
      (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryPlusCompIso _ _).symm ≪≫
        Functor.mapDerivedCategoryPlusNatIso (asIso (baseChangeMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
          sq.toCommSq)) ≪≫ Functor.mapDerivedCategoryPlusCompIso _ _
    (∀ {Z Z' Z'' T T' T'' : Scheme.{u}}
      (i : Z ⟶ T) (i' : Z' ⟶ T') (i'' : Z'' ⟶ T'')
      [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsClosedImmersion i'] [IsClosedImmersion i'']
      (h : Z' ⟶ Z) (g : T' ⟶ T) (h₂ : Z'' ⟶ Z') (g₂ : T'' ⟶ T')
      (sq : IsPullback h i' i g) (sq₂ : IsPullback h₂ i'' i' g₂),
      TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (c i i'' (h₂ ≫ h) (g₂ ≫ g) (sq₂.paste_horiz sq)).inv =
        (((TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (c i i' h g sq).inv ≫ₕ
          TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (c i' i'' h₂ g₂ sq₂).inv).whiskerTop
          (upperStarCompDerivedPlus (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h₂ h).hom).whiskerBottom
          (upperStarCompDerivedPlus (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g₂ g).inv)) ∧
    (∀ {Z T : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ T) [IsClosedImmersion i],
      TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (c i i (𝟙 Z) (𝟙 T) (IsPullback.id_horiz i)).inv =
        ((TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _
          ((Functor.leftUnitor (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i).mapDerivedCategoryPlus).hom ≫
            (Functor.rightUnitor _).inv)).whiskerTop
            (upperStarIdDerivedPlus (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Z).hom).whiskerBottom
            (upperStarIdDerivedPlus (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) T).inv)
